summary: MXFP8 MTP draft experts can run on B12X
compatibility: No user action required. The default is unchanged: the launcher keeps moe_backend auto for MXFP8 drafters (docker-114), which picks Marlin. To try B12X, pass an explicit --speculative-config with "moe_backend": "b12x".
details: The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next QAD step 5500 checkpoint (revision qad-step5500-ple1000) ships its MTP draft experts as MXFP8 while the target experts are NVFP4. With moe_backend b12x in the speculative config, ModelOpt MXFP8 experts now run on B12X instead of failing kernel selection.

On RTX PRO 6000 TP2 the B12X drafter is correct and accepts slightly more draft tokens (2.34-2.37 against 2.30-2.34 per step with Marlin), but decode is not faster: C1 196-209 against 200-220 tok/s, C8 949-955 against 960-961 tok/s.

moe_backend b12x for MXFP8 experts is rejected at startup, with a message, when the installed B12X has no MXFP8 recipe or when the checkpoint is not a ModelOpt MXFP8 export (compressed-tensors, INC, online MXFP8).
